information: # Little Cubes in Bacolod 2026 Welcome to **Little Cubes in Bacolod 2026!** Join us for a fun day of cubing featuring the following events: - 3x3x3 Cube - 2x2x2 Cube - 3x3x3 One-Handed - Clock - Pyraminx - Skewb ### Unofficial FTO Event We'll also have an **unofficial FTO event** as we prepare for its expected addition to official WCA competitions in January 2027. - **Limited slots:** Only the first 10 participants to register can join. - **Time limit:** 2 minutes per solve. While FTO results won't be recorded in the WCA yet, we'll record them on **Cubing Contests** so everyone can check their times and see how they stack up. **Interested in joining the FTO event?** Please indicate your interest in the notes section when registering. Slots are limited to the first 10 participants, so sign up early! ### Important Notes - Competitors or their guardians must agree that the organizers, PCA, and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage, or loss resulting from participation in this event. - Please read the **[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**. - Please check the **Competitor Guide and Updates** tab for any changes. - Please check the **Events and Schedules** tab for more information. See you there, and happy cubing! 🧩
